A <c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> that walks on two feet, like a human. It
has the most variations, and its <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> vary by {{part}}. It
struggles on unstable {{terrain}}.

<c:ffff00>{{terrain|cap}} {{affinity|cap}}<c> (<c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>):
  <c:ffff00>{{plains}}<c> +4, <c:ffff00>{{forest}}<c> +6, <c:ffff00>{{rocky_ground}}<c> +4, <c:ffff00>{{sand}}<c> -6,
  <c:ffff00>{{tundra}}<c> -6, <c:ffff00>{{hall}}<c> +4, <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c> -6, <c:ffff00>{{cyber}}<c> +4.
  <c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{sky}}<c>: {{robattle|pl}} not possible.
